parsed.name: NI-XNET CAN总线接口
parsed.description: 用于将计算机连接到CAN/CAN FD网络的总线接口设备，常用于实验室中的汽车电子、ECU与工业控制通信测试、报文收发和总线故障排查。
parsed.description_en: A bus interface device that connects a computer to a CAN/CAN FD network. It is commonly used in labs for automotive electronics, ECU and industrial communication testing, message transmission and reception, and bus troubleshooting.

actions.description: 复位CAN网络接口并清除控制器错误状态
actions.description_en: Reset the CAN network interface and clear controller error states
